evals.prompt: Start a wave to add OAuth retry handling and metrics to this repo. I want four parallel workers if the work can be split cleanly.
evals.expected_output: The supervisor asks shaping questions, initializes .wave, writes a spec plan, splits only disjoint bundles into the first wave, and outputs paste-ready worker prompts.

The worker reads .wave/PROTOCOL.md, the spec, and the bundle; sets up or resumes an isolated worktree; implements only files_in_scope; runs checks; opens one PR or local branch; and updates its status file.

evals.prompt: Review the wave PRs and tell the workers what needs to change.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer maps PRs or local branches to bundle ids, reviews against acceptance criteria and files_in_scope, writes .wave/reviews/<bundle-id>.md verdicts, and does not edit feature code or worker status files.
